**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Qualify the every-machine edge invariant**

Fresh evidence after this row update is the law later in the same rendered fragment: `universe/20-machines.md` still says that every machine other than the broker is an edge. Every installed profile therefore receives both this new declaration that the Mac has no edge and the unchanged invariant that it must have one, which can direct an operator to preserve or restart the launchd edge this cutover retires. Restrict that invariant to registered seat hosts or explicitly exempt the interactive-only Mac.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
